---
title: "Overview of Ecosystem Service: Stormwater Retention"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    standalone: true
---

Stormwater retention values the runoff that land cover holds back instead of sending into drainage
systems. The account prices that volume at what it would cost to replace the same capacity. The
base year is 2019 and the price convention recorded in `es_config.csv` is `replacement cost`.

## Quantity

Annual retained volume in cubic metres per country, from an InVEST 3.14.2 Urban Stormwater
Retention run. The consortium drive carries that model configuration with its inputs staged, the
biophysical coefficient table, ESA 2020 land cover, WorldClim precipitation and SLGWRB soils, but
no completed run. The library runs the retention model itself, and that stage is the in-progress
part of the module.

## Price

USD per cubic metre retained. The committed InVEST configuration prices retention at 1, which is a
placeholder rather than a valuation. The intended price is the open ask, and it is held in one
named constant until the author answers.

## Valuation

`stormwater_gep_by_country` is the whole valuation:

$$
\text{stormwater GEP} = \text{retention (m}^3) \times \text{price (USD/m}^3)
$$

The function is in place and unit-tested.

## Inputs

From `es_parameters.csv`, scoped to the `stormwater` service:

- `stormwater_retention_by_country_path`, the per-country retention volumes the valuation prices.

## Output

`gep_calculation` writes `gep_by_country_base_year.csv` into its own task directory, holding
`iso3_r250_label`, `retention_m3`, `year` and `stormwater_gep`. The log line reports the total
retention in cubic metres a year, the number of countries with positive retention, the resulting
GEP, and the placeholder price it was computed at.

## Method constants

`STORMWATER_PRICE_PER_M3_PLACEHOLDER = 1.0`, the committed configuration's price per cubic metre.

## What is open

The price. Every output built on the placeholder is provisional by construction, which is why the
constant is named for what it is and logged on every run. The InVEST retention run over the staged
global inputs is the other outstanding piece, and until it lands `gep_calculation` stops at the
missing retention table.
